name: knowledgeware
description: Style-driven deliverable suite with a central brand registry. Five skills sharing one brandbook format: slideware (.pptx decks via pptxgenjs), slideware-revealjs (HTML decks via Reveal.js), study-guide (multi-page HTML knowledge bases), chartware (draw.io architecture diagrams), and brandware (brand/style registry manager with website derivation and logo-asset gathering). One visual identity, every medium; proprietary brandbooks stay in a private overlay.
